source_refs.note: Applications of PCR: a main subheading of 20.3.1 Steps of PCR, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 162-162.

items: Yeh bimari phelane wale jaraseem (infectious agents) ke genotypes pehchanne ki behtareen diagnostic (tashkhees ki) technique hai.
Is se woh genetic mutations pakri jati hain jo kuch genetic bimariyon aur cancers ka sabab hain.
Jurm ki tafteesh mein sookhe khoon ke bohat chhote namoone ya insaan ke aik baal ki jar ke cells se “DNA fingerprints” banaye jate hain.
Doctor bohat shuru ke embryos (janeen) ke chand jhare hue (sloughed-off) cells le kar un ka DNA barha kar genetic nuqs (defects) maloom kar sakte hain.
PCR se extinct (khatam ho chuki) species ka DNA bhi jancha jata hai, bas shart yeh hai ke un ke DNA ki bohat thori si miqdar bhi saalim bachi ho.

blocks.prompt: Aik DNA molecule se shuru kar ke 5 PCR cycles ke baad kitni copies hongi?
blocks.explanation: Har cycle copies dugni karti hai: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2⁵ = 32 copies. Isi tarah 20 cycles ke baad 2²⁰ = 1,048,576, yaani das laakh se zyada copies.

items: Denaturation (taqreeban 98°C): DNA single strands mein alag.
Annealing (taqreeban 60°C): forward aur backward primers complementary jagahon se jurte hain.
Extension (optimum 72°C): Taq polymerase (Thermus aquaticus se) primer ke 3’ sire par nucleotides jorta hai.
Har cycle 1-2 minute, DNA dugna; 20 cycles mein das laakh se zyada copies.
Istemal: infections ki tashkhees, mutations, DNA fingerprints, embryos ki jaanch, extinct species ka DNA, genomic library.
